chapter: Well Done! What's the Next Big Plan?
act_title: Well Done! What's the Next Big Plan?

quests.title: Well Done! What's the Next Big Plan?

dialogue.sit: Took quite a few photos this time.

dialogue.t: That's wonderful! Thank you so much for your help!
While you were busy taking those photos, I started thinking I can't just stand by and do nothing, or I'll never make any progress...
So I worked up the courage to ask a few passersby for help, and I even managed to take quite a few shots myself! I think that should be plenty of data for testing.
Heh, I knew you wouldn't let me down! Thanks to {NICKNAME} for stepping in as well.
Lepine-Pauline! When did you get back? Ninette said you've been busy with something else lately.
Well obviously, it's a massive deal — enough to fill my pockets to the brim!
Things got pretty busy for me lately, so I'm really glad you were there to help Ninette out.
She's got the talent and the taste, that's for sure. She's just a bit shy. But with your help, she's really taken an important step forward.
So, what's this "massive deal" you've been so mysterious about? Don't tell Paimon you heard another wild rumor and went all in again!
What? Of course not! I've learned my lesson. This time it's the real deal — safe and sure to make a fortune!
Hmph, if I tell you now, it'll ruin the surprise. Once it's done, you'll be the first to try it out!

quests.description: With your help, the lens testing is finally complete. But now that Lepine-Pauline has suddenly shown up, it looks like she’s already planning another big business venture…
